Spanish 21 it is. It's blackjack played with a 48-card deck that has all the 10s taken out (jacks, queens and kings stay in). Your 21 always wins, and your blackjack beats the dealer's blackjack. Bonus payouts apply for a 21 made with five or more cards, and for 6-7-8 or 7-7-7. You can double after splitting and surrender late. Otherwise, the usual blackjack rules apply.

You start with 1,000 chips. Set your bet on the table and deal.
